requested_primary_changes.reason: All three reachable financial MCP client call paths invoke core.observability.traced_call_tool. That helper wraps session.call_tool with a bare @traceable and has no process_inputs or process_outputs. LangSmith can therefore persist the complete arguments and complete MCP result, including ForecastContext plus raw prices, statements, XBRL facts, filing text/accessions, DCF scenarios, checker-derived arguments and provider error payloads. The five FinancialAnalystAgent decorators have allowlisted processors, but those processors do not sanitize child MCP spans.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Stop using the raw traced_call_tool wrapper from the Financial Stage 05 path. Trace each MCP call through a Stage05-safe wrapper or direct call whose process_inputs/process_outputs return only allowlisted identity and compact lifecycle metadata: stage=05, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=financial, run_id, ticker, as_of, target, horizon, analysis_mode, dataset/feature/model/schema versions, allowlisted tool/operation/provider, measured latency_ms, compact counts, outcome, missing/degraded flags and stable error_code. Never emit task_query, plan, messages, MCP arguments, raw result, prices, statements, XBRL facts, filing text, accession payloads, DCF arrays or exceptions. Add a mocked LangSmith-processor sentinel that injects PRIVATE_SENTINEL into every prohibited input/output class and proves it is absent while identity/count/outcome remain present.

requested_primary_changes.reason: financial_server.py logs raw financial scalar inputs at numerous ratio/valuation callsites, including price/EPS, enterprise value/EBITDA, revenue/COGS/income/equity/assets/debt/cash/FCF/market-cap/current-liability inputs, DCF/reverse-DCF inputs and other statement-derived values. These are business payloads, not allowlisted operational metadata. The agent also logs a final calculated composite score/grade and several free-form operational messages; the numeric tool-input logs are independently sufficient to violate the no raw prices/statements/facts/DCF payload policy.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Replace payload-bearing financial logs with fixed event codes and allowlisted fields only. Tool names must be validated against the fixed Stage05 registry; numeric telemetry must be finite, bounded operational scalars such as latency/count/loop/score only, never financial input/output values. Keep Sentry capture_message stable-code-only and never capture exceptions. Add caplog/progress/Sentry sentinels that inject PRIVATE_SENTINEL and extreme/non-finite numeric financial values through ratio, DCF, provider failure and agent paths and prove none is persisted; separately prove bounded checker score/count/boolean lifecycle fields are normalized or omitted.

requested_primary_changes.reason: The Stage05 source has only one elapsed_latency_ms call, for whole-agent completion. There is no compact measured lifecycle matrix at SEC submissions, companyfacts, filing-selection/text and restatement gates; Yahoo adjusted-history and current-only fail-closed gates; ratio/MCP dispatcher; monthly adapter; or agent extraction, calculation, checker and pre-Shared-State gates. Existing progress events carry partial counts/outcomes but no measured per-boundary latency and no single allowlisted provenance contract. No Stage05 sentinel asserts the required matrix.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Add one deterministic compact lifecycle builder derived from the immutable Stage05 implementation identity. Instrument every required boundary with monotonic measured latency_ms and the available run/ticker/as_of/target/horizon/mode plus dataset/feature/model/schema/provider/operation, compact input/result/evidence/accession/eligible/rejected/missing counts, fixed outcome and degraded flags. Do not fabricate unavailable measurements and do not store payloads. Add an exact offline lifecycle-matrix sentinel covering SEC submissions/companyfacts/filing/restatement acceptance and rejection, Yahoo adjusted history/current-only fail-closed, dispatcher/ratio, monthly adapter, agent extraction/calculation/checker and pre-State. Assert finite non-negative measured latency, attempt identity, stable error codes and no raw payload/private marker.
